_doc: The heroes' secondary abilities (the user's list of 2026-11-08b, docs/improvements9.txt, its sixth phase: 'earned in the wilderness by gathering materials and making Angel Tokens'). 911 writes them as the generators' Secondaries on every map of the game, the two wilderness materials and the Angel Token as items, and the token's recipe at the anvil. An Angel Token used from the inventory raises one of her hero's abilities a rank (six ranks; the first rank learns it). Each ability: id (its name in the game, '@<id>' on the quick bar), hero, title, kind (active: on the quick bar with its cooldown; toggle: on the bar, on and off; passive: always), the values by rank (values, values2: what each is is in 'text'), the cooldowns by rank (seconds), the seconds it lasts by rank, its reach (cm). The user gave no cooldown for the Warrior's, the Summoner's healing and the Martial Artist's movements, no numbers for the Warlock's mana blade and no time for iron skin: those are ours, marked 'ours'. The Rogue has none in the list.

token.looks: a token of white gold with a pair of wings: used, it raises one of your hero's secondary abilities a rank

materials.looks: a long white feather that glows faintly: the wilderness's monsters carry them
a pale stone warm to the touch, found where the old shrines stood

abilities.title: Shield Bash
abilities.text: stuns every enemy within reach in front of her for {v} s

abilities.title: Grapple
abilities.text: holds the enemy before her where it stands for {v} s (it still strikes)

abilities.title: Trip
abilities.text: throws the enemy before her prone for {v} s: it neither moves nor strikes

abilities.title: Blinding Strike
abilities.text: a blow of her weapon that blinds the enemy before her for {v} s (its blows miss)

abilities.title: Sweeping Push
abilities.text: pushes every enemy within reach {v} m away from her

abilities.title: Pulling Attack
abilities.text: pulls an enemy up to {v} m away before her into her reach

abilities.title: Mana Swarm
abilities.text: seeking points of light at one enemy: one for every {v} mana she has left, each a third of a fire bolt

abilities.title: Mana Recharge Shield
abilities.text: for {s} s each blow that reaches her becomes mana instead of hurting her

abilities.title: Ablation Shield
abilities.text: for {s} s, {v} layers: each blow peels a layer away and strikes its maker back
abilities.ours: cooldown, the blow struck back (the blow's own)

abilities.title: Misty Step
abilities.text: steps up to {v} m away from her foes, to a safe place

abilities.title: Spell Boost
abilities.text: one spell she chooses does {v} times its damage, for good

abilities.title: Second Spell Boost
abilities.text: a second spell she chooses does {v} times its damage, for good

abilities.title: Mana Shield
abilities.text: for {s} s her mana takes the blows instead of her, a point for a point

abilities.title: Curse Shield
abilities.text: for {s} s every enemy within 2 m of her is cursed (it takes {v}% more and strikes for less)

abilities.title: Blinding Shield
abilities.text: for {s} s every enemy within 2 m of her is blinded (its blows miss)

abilities.title: Misty Transfer
abilities.text: sends the enemy before her {v} m away, elsewhere in the area

abilities.title: Bleeding Shield
abilities.text: for {s} s every enemy within 2 m of her bleeds {v} a second
abilities.ours: the bleeding (a second, before her growth)

abilities.title: Mana Blade
abilities.text: while on, each blow that lands takes {v2} mana and does {v} times that more damage

abilities.title: Minion Health
abilities.text: her summons have {v} times their hit points

abilities.title: Minion Damage
abilities.text: her summons strike {v} times as hard

abilities.title: Summon Healing
abilities.text: heals each of her summons by {v}% of its hit points

abilities.title: Frenzy
abilities.text: her summons strike {v} times as often

abilities.title: Soul Harvest
abilities.text: each enemy dying near her heals her summons by {v2}% and makes their blows {v} times as hard for 10 s
abilities.ours: the boost's 10 s, near her: 25 m

abilities.title: Wall Run
abilities.text: a leap of up to {v} m: up walls and across gaps without climbing gear

abilities.title: Flash Steps
abilities.text: a dash of up to {v} m that passes through enemies

abilities.title: Water Walk
abilities.text: runs across water for up to {v} m

abilities.title: Parry
abilities.text: for {s} s each blow from in front of her is turned aside and staggers its maker
abilities.ours: the stagger's 1.5 s; the timing is the mode's own (each blow in front parried)

abilities.title: Iron Skin
abilities.text: for {s} s every blow that reaches her is {v}% weaker
